{{Top|leg}}
'''Ergesh language''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Ergesh]].

The Ergesh language was said to sound like thick mud coming out of a rapid boil. Ergesh were very wet, and fluid meant everything to them, so there was no word in the Ergesh language to mean "dry"; there was a word though, meaning "not wet", which was usually used as a curse. Most members of the Ergesh [[Species/Legends|species]] preferred to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], though it sounded as if the speaker was talking underwater.
